'''The Nine Rings''' can refer to the following:

* ''[[The Great Hunt/Chapter 21|The Nine Rings]]'' - the twenty-first chapter of ''[[The Great Hunt]]''.
* [[The Nine Rings (inn)|The Nine Rings]] - an inn in [[Cairhien]].
* ''[[The Nine Rings (story)|The Nine Rings]]'' - an adventure story.

==Parallels==

The name "The Nine Rings" [[Similarities to Tolkien|is a reference]] to Tolkien's ''[[w:c:lotr:The Lord of the Rings|The Lord of the Rings]]'' in general and the [[w:c:lotr:Rings of Power#The_Nine|nine rings of power]] given to Men in particular.
